_doc: General command orders (ui/GeneralsPanel.tsx, game/workers/generalOrders.ts, DefenderSystem.followMinionOrder). Each General carries an ordered list of up to 3 priorities (roster orders) and one for its minions (minionOrders); scopes pick who an order goes to. Every frame a unit follows the first priority whose target is on the island (the Kirov only for flyers / long-range fighters) and falls back to AUTO; a live order pulls a General into battle at once. Rage fills from combat (dealing / taking damage, clashes); two Generals at full rage can be ordered to brawl. 'invest' turns a General's brawl bonus (+attack / +HP) into extra max HP (sturdiness) for its own establishment and resets the bonus.
